from typing import Literal
import mas_operators as operator
from . import prompt as prompt_custom
from scripts.async_llm import create_llm_instance


from scripts.evaluator import DatasetType

class Workflow:
    def __init__(
        self,
        name: str,
        llm_config,
        dataset: DatasetType,
        aggregator_llm_config=None,
    ) -> None:
        self.name = name
        self.dataset = dataset
        self.llm = create_llm_instance(llm_config)
        self.aggregator_llm = create_llm_instance(aggregator_llm_config) if aggregator_llm_config else self.llm

    async def __call__(self, problem: str):
        solve = operator.Sequential(
            llm=self.llm,
            num_rounds=2,
            prompts=[prompt_custom.PUZZLE_SOLVE_PROMPT + "\n\n{problem}", prompt_custom.PUZZLE_SOLVE_PROMPT + "\n\nRe-check the puzzle and improve this draft if needed:\n{previous_output}\n\nOriginal puzzle:\n{problem}"],
        )
        draft = await solve(problem)
        fmt = operator.Sequential(
            llm=self.aggregator_llm,
            num_rounds=1,
            prompts=[prompt_custom.PUZZLE_WRAP_PROMPT + "\n\nOriginal problem:\n{problem}\n\nDraft answer:\n{previous_output}"],
        )
        solution = await fmt(draft["response"] if draft and draft.get("response") else "()")
        return (solution["response"] if solution and solution.get("response") else "```\n(0,0)\n```"), {
            "worker": self.llm.get_usage_delta(),
            "aggregator": self.aggregator_llm.get_usage_delta(),
        }

- If a shorter valid chain exists, use it instead of a longer one.

"""
